messages:
marta: Lodestar POC kickoff — customer wants Kite-65B in their VPC (private deploy). Must meet HIPAA, integrate with their KMS, and have predictable latency SLOs. Sales asked for catalog-fit notes and a rough committed-cost delta vs our 13/34B offerings. Any immediate concerns?
ryan: Biggest unknowns: tokenizer/vocab compatibility, whether model uses rotary vs ALiBi/rope (kernel choices), and KV-cache memory per session. Also figure out target quant scheme (q8_0 or q4 variants).
tara: Infra note: recommend 4x A100-80GB with KV sharding for sustained throughput, or 2x H100 with nvlink for lower tail latency. Private deploy requires reserved capacity and network diagram for our ops.
ales: Suggested quick POC config for dev to validate:

```
model: kite-65b-v1
variant: lodestar-poc-1
quant: q4_K_M
tokenizer: byte-bpe (verify)
kv_shards: 4
hw_preference: A100-80GB
max_seq_len: 4096
expected_rps: 3-8
```

ales: If tokenizer mismatches we can add a small mapping/transcoding layer but expect a perf hit.
ryan: If they go q4 we should run evals on their prompt set — q4 sometimes regresses on long-context tasks. I'll queue an eval when artifact + prompts are in staging.
nina: Security checklist: vendor questionnaire, model provenance (license and weight origin), artifact checksums, and confirmation of no outbound telemetry. For HIPAA: KMS audit logs and signed DPA are required.
marta: Sales will start legal/DPA. Can someone give a back-of-envelope perf delta: q4 vs q8 and A100 vs H100 to share with customer?
tara: I can run microbenchmarks once artifact and a 20-entry prompt set are uploaded to staging. ETA 48 hours for baselines on both A100 and H100 and q8/q4 variants.
ryan: I'll run tokenizer and variant-scan after upload. Ping me with S3 path or presigned link.
deploy-bot: queued DJ-1291 — infra-staging deploy job for kite-65b-v1 pending artifact upload (scheduled 2026-04-01T14:00:00Z).
marta: Action items: (1) Sales upload artifact + eval prompts (marta/sales) (2) Ryan: tokenizer + variant-scan (ryan) (3) Tara: perf baselines A100/H100 and q4/q8 (tara) (4) Nina: collect security docs + DPA (nina) (5) Ales/finance: ballpark committed vs hosted delta for 65B. 20-min sync tomorrow 11:30 PT? :thumbsup:
ales: I'll fetch a finance ballpark and drop numbers here today.
marta: Thanks — I'll send invite and a short checklist doc for Sales to hand to Lodestar.
